controles.affirmation: Hook et argument : 'Vistra a emis 4,0 Mds $ d'obligations en avril 2026 pour financer une acquisition qui n'est meme pas encore close' / '4,0 Mds $ d'obligations senior non garanties, en partie pour financer la transaction Cogentrix'
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2026, Vistra Operations issued $4.0 billion aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes ... Net proceeds totaling approximately $3.968 billion were used to repay or redeem existing indebtedness, including the Company's 5.625% Senior Notes due 2027 and the Term Loan B-3 Facility, and to pay fees and expenses related to the offering. Excess net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. // In January 2026, Vistra Operations issued $2.25 billion aggregate principal amount of senior secured notes ... Net proceeds totaling approximately $2.230 billion, together with cash on hand, were or will be used (i) to fund a portion of the consideration for the Cogentrix Transaction
controles.correction_proposee: L'emission d'avril 2026 est un refinancement : elle a servi a rembourser les Senior Notes 5,625% 2027 et le Term Loan B-3 (2,444 Md$), pas a financer Cogentrix. C'est l'emission de janvier 2026 (2,25 Md$ de notes senior GARANTIES) qui finance une partie de Cogentrix. Reformuler le hook : 'Vistra a leve 2,25 Mds $ en janvier 2026 pour financer en partie une acquisition qui n'est toujours pas close, puis 4,0 Mds $ en avril pour refinancer sa dette existante'.

controles.affirmation: Dette long terme 19 595 M$ au 30 juin 2026 contre 17 043 M$ au 31 decembre 2025 (+15%) ; capitaux propres 5 494 M$ pour un bilan de 42 603 M$, soit 12,9%
controles.verbatim_source: Long-term debt including amounts due currently | $19,595 | $17,043 ; Stockholders' equity 5,482 ; Total equity 5,494 ; Total liabilities and equity $42,603

controles.affirmation: Cogentrix : environ 2,3 Mds $ en cash plus 1,5 Md $ de dette reprise, cloture attendue fin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Aggregate consideration at closing will consist of approximately (i) $2.3 billion in cash, net of adjustments for the assumption of an estimated $1.5 billion of outstanding indebtedness ... and (ii) 5,000,000 shares of Vistra common stock ... at a mutually agreed-upon value of $185 per share. ... The Cogentrix Transaction is expected to close in late 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Omission : l'ATT ne mentionne pas la composante en titres (5 000 000 actions valorisees 185 $, soit environ 925 M$). A ajouter pour etre complet.

controles.affirmation: 'le calendrier de retour en service de la facility 100 MW reste incertain et la 300 MW, dont la valeur nette comptable atteint encore 311 M$, n'a pas de date de redemarrage fixee'
controles.verbatim_source: we wrote off the net book value of Moss Landing 300 of approximately $400 million to depreciation expense during the three months ended March 31, 2025. We also determined not to return the Moss Landing 100 MW battery facility to service and recognized an impairment loss of approximately $155 million during the three months ended December 31, 2025. ... We are working towards a return to service of the Moss Landing 350 MW battery facility in 2026; however, there continues to be uncertainty regarding when or if the facility will return to service ... The facility had a net book value of approximately $311 million as of June 30, 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Confusion de sites. Les 311 M$ de VNC et l'incertitude de redemarrage concernent la facility 350 MW. La 300 MW a ete integralement depreciee (~400 M$) et ne reviendra pas en service ; la 100 MW ne reviendra pas non plus (depreciation de ~155 M$ au T4 2025) : son calendrier n'est pas 'incertain', il est arrete. Reformuler : 'la 350 MW, encore inscrite pour 311 M$ au bilan, n'a pas de date de redemarrage certaine ; les 300 MW et 100 MW ont ete definitivement sorties'.

controles.affirmation: Remediation Moss Landing negociee avec l'EPA estimee a environ 175 M$ dont une hausse de 65 M$ au seul T2 2026 ; indemnisation assurance de 500 M$ integralement percue
controles.verbatim_source: In July 2025, we entered into an Administrative Settlement Agreement and Order on Consent (ASAOC) with the EPA related to the Moss Landing 300 site ... Total costs are currently estimated at approximately $175 million, including a $65 million increase recorded during the second quarter of 2026 ... We have filed insurance claims against applicable insurance policies with combined business interruption and property loss limits of $500 million, net of deductibles, all of which has been fully collected as of February 2026.

ERCOT : plafond abaisse a 2 000 $/MWh des que le peaker net margin depasse trois fois le CONE ; PJM plafonne les offres a 1 000 $/MWh sauf justification de couts ; en ERCOT les renouvelables ou le thermique bas cout fixent le prix quand la production renouvelable est abondante
controles.verbatim_source: If the peaker net margin exceeds a threshold of three-times the Cost of New Entry (CONE) reference price, the maximum point on each ASDC is reduced to the low system-wide offer cap of $2,000/MWh for the remainder of the calendar year. / Offers into the energy markets are capped at $1,000/MWh unless a resource can cost justify an offer above $1,000/MWh. / When renewable generation is abundant relative to demand, prices are set by either renewable resources or low-cost thermal resources.

controles.affirmation: Winter Storm Uri : motion rejetee par la Cour supreme du Texas le 24 juillet 2026
controles.verbatim_source: On June 15, 2026, the plaintiffs filed a motion for reconsideration and for consolidated rehearing at the Supreme Court of Texas, and, on July 24, 2026, the court denied the motion
